description: This Java class 'EdgeEntityProcessor' extends 'BaseEdgeProcessor' and handles processing of edge entity notifications and converting edge events to downlink messages within the Thingsboard platform. It manages edge-related events such as assignment and unassignment to customers, and interacts with services like EdgeService and UserService.

classes.name: EdgeEntityProcessor
classes.description: A processor class for handling edge entity notifications and converting edge events to downlink messages in the Thingsboard platform.

methods.name: processEntityNotification
methods.description: Processes notifications related to edge entities, handling actions like assignment and unassignment to customers, and generating corresponding edge events.

methods.name: convertEdgeEventToDownlink
methods.description: Converts an edge event into a downlink message for communication with edge devices, specifically for assignment and unassignment actions.

methods.name: getEdgeEventType
methods.description: Returns the type of edge event this processor handles, which is 'EDGE'.
